verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs describe an open-source toolkit for building AI applications on Postgres and pgvector, and the homepage lists Vector embeddings as a core building block. Together these cover storing embeddings and running similarity search in the project database. missing for 10: detailed evidence of similarity-search queries, distance operators and vector indexing (e.g. HNSW/IVFFlat), and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search in practice.
